clips.text: Thank you for calling Green Valley Health member services. This is Mina speaking on a recorded line. Can I confirm I'm speaking with Daniel Mercer, born July 18, 1982, and living at 4827 Willow Creek Drive, Apt 5B, Columbus, Ohio 43215?
Yes, this is Daniel Andrew Mercer. The last four of my Social Security number are 4421, and my member ID is GVH-88394127.
Thank you, Mr. Mercer. For verification, can you confirm the phone number and email we have on file: 614-555-0198, and daniel.mercer82@protonmail.com?
Yes, that's right, although my new callback number is 380-555-4412, and my employer is Harrison Industrial Company at 2150 Fisher Road, Columbus, Ohio.
I see your plan is under policy number PPO-77-194402, and the primary care physician listed is Dr. Elena Ruiz at Buckeye Family Clinic, 903 East Main Street, Columbus, Ohio 43205.

That's correct. I'm calling about a claim for my MRI from March 3, 2026, after I injured my lower back lifting equipment. The diagnosis code on my paperwork says M54.5, and the imaging center was Riverside Diagnostic Imaging.
I found that claim. It shows service date 03/03/2026, account number AC-5501938, billed amount $2,480, and it references your prior authorization number PA-2048816.
I also had a prescription denied. It was for Gabapentin 300 mg, prescribed by Dr. Elena Ruiz for nerve pain, and my pharmacy is CVS number 11472, 3588 West Broad Street, Columbus, Ohio.
I can see that medication request. To verify, your emergency contact is Melissa Mercer, spouse, at 614-555-8871, and your preferred mailing address is still P.O. Box 11842, Columbus, Ohio 43211?
Yes, and my wife's date of birth is November 2, 1984. Also, the hospital can fax records to my attorney, Kevin L. Shore, at 216-555-7714, because this relates to a workplace injury claim.

Understood. I also see notes from your recent visit indicating type 2 diabetes, hypertension, and an A1C of 8.1%. The lab order was submitted under requisition number LAB-662901 from St. Anne's Outpatient Center.

Thanks. Please send the appeal form to Daniel.A.Mercer@outlook.com, and mail a copy to 4827 Willow Creek Drive, Apt 5B, Columbus, Ohio 43215. If you need payment for the balance, my HSA card ending in 9034 is available.
